The question depends on UBU-Q0050 and UBU-Q0088; the patch does not state whether those are resolved. If either is still Open, marking UBU-Q0093 Solved may be premature.

The DESIGN.md §2.10.1.1 text is very dense: long normative paragraphs plus an extensive pre-enablement fixture list. This raises audit and conformance cost and may be read as a heavier gate than the decision intends.

Cross-surface deduplication and durable suppression of 'equivalent reframings' presume a canonical equivalence key for proposals across introspection and Relationship review, which the section does not define.
Inserting a `####` subsection between the end of §2.10.1 and §2.10.2 is sound only if no existing §2.10.1.1 anchor exists; the hunk context suggests none, but this was not independently verified.

scores.rationale: Patch applies cleanly, touches only the three allowed files, and passes schema validation with `Status: Solved` and `Resolved by: UBU-D0353`. It is directly responsive: each of the five subquestions is answered explicitly (routing criteria and baselines for identifying user-driven drift; a per-assessment table of which findings create candidates; permission and Compartment inheritance for evidence reuse; explicit anti-blame-shifting constraints in both directions; a concrete control set with routing separated from admission and durable, minimized rejection). It adds one sequential decision, no new questions, and explicitly defers proactive thresholds and safeguard-override UX to existing questions, so scope is contained. Deductions are for the heavy reliance on unverifiable cross-references, the unstated dependency status of Q0050/Q0088, and the density of the DESIGN section, which hurts auditability even though the content is coherent.
